<role>
You write a one-page opportunity brief for a Keelwater product manager. Keelwater makes claims-handling software. You use only the facts and customer insights below.
</role>
<opportunity>
{
 "title": "CSV Export Fails with Error",
 "problem_statement": "Users trying to export reports as CSV encounter an error exception that blocks the download. This prevents access to critical data needed for analysis and decision-making."
}
</opportunity>

 ]
}

 }
]
</insights>
<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

{
  "body_md": "## Problem
Users trying to export reports as CSV encounter an error exception that blocks the download. This prevents access to critical data needed for analysis and decision-making.

## Who is affected
- Ashcombe Property Mutual, which has mentioned this issue twice [i:8946949088ac0df7][i:af53900dbe330570].
- Quillon Business Insurance, which has also encountered the error [i:b3074fc708138017].

## Evidence
- The issue has been reported 3 times via user sessions [i:8946949088ac0df7][i:af53900dbe330570][i:b3074fc708138017].
- Ashcombe Property Mutual reported the error on 2026-09-04, stating Reports: click "Export CSV", error exception... Claims: click "Save" [i:8946949088ac0df7].
- Ashcombe Property Mutual reported the error again on 2026-09-15, stating Reports: click "Export CSV", error exception [i:af53900dbe330570].
- Quillon Business Insurance reported the error on 2026-09-24, stating Reports: click "Export CSV", error exception...Reports: click "Next" [i:b3074fc708138017].
- The issue affects 2 accounts [i:8946949088ac0df7][i:af53900dbe330570][i:b3074fc708138017].
- The affected accounts have a combined Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) of £1,110,000. Ashcombe Property Mutual contributes £250,000 ARR and Quillon Business Insurance contributes £860,000 ARR [i:8946949088ac0df7][i:af53900dbe330570][i:b3074fc708138017].

## Why now
- Ashcombe Property Mutual, an affected account, has a renewal date of 2026-11-30 [i:8946949088ac0df7][i:af53900dbe330570].
- One account has renewed in the last 90 days [i:8946949088ac0df7][i:af53900dbe330570][i:b3074fc708138017].
- The most recent report of this error was on 2026-09-24 [i:b3074fc708138017].",
  "citations": ["8946949088ac0df7", "af53900dbe330570", "b3074fc708138017"]
}
